description: This file defines the TalkModeController class, responsible for managing the state and behavior of the Talk Mode feature in a macOS app. It handles enabling/disabling talk mode, updating phases and levels, pausing/resuming, and stopping speech, coordinating with other components such as overlay controllers, connection handlers, and runtime services.

classes.name: TalkModeController
classes.description: A singleton controller class managing the state and interactions of the talk mode feature, handling UI updates, state transitions, and communication with runtime and server components.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables talk mode, updating UI overlays and notifying runtime services. Conditionally refreshes voice wake runtime if disabling and swabble is enabled.

methods.name: updatePhase
methods.description: Sets the current talk mode phase and updates the UI overlay and remote connection with the current phase, considering pause state.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the visual level indicator for talk mode.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Pauses or resumes talk mode, updates UI, and informs remote connection and runtime services.

methods.name: togglePaused
methods.description: Toggles the paused state of talk mode.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Commands the runtime to stop speaking, with an optional reason.

methods.name: exitTalkMode
methods.description: Disables talk mode in the app state store.
